interface.description: Top module `nano_cgra_3x3_sobel_accelerator_v4` ports: input clk, input rst_async_n, input data_i, output data_o. Interface is BIT-SERIAL (UART-style): payload enters on `data_i` and leaves on `data_o`, one bit per baud period of 434 clock cycles, 8 data bits per frame, LSB first, with a low start bit and a high stop bit. Data geometry: input 32x32, output 30x30 bytes.
